description_en: Queries the notifications of an ApsaraDB RDS instance
description_zh: 该接口用于查询RDS的通知
name: QueryNotify

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the query results contain confirmed notifications. Valid values:

true
false

A confirmed notification is a notification that has been marked as confirmed by calling the ConfirmNotify operation
parameters.help_zh:
查询结果中是否包含已确认的通知。取值：
true：包含
false：不包含
已确认的通知即已通过ConfirmNotify接口标记为已确认的通知
parameters.name: with_confirmed

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.name: from

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. The end time must be later than the start time. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，需要晚于开始时间。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: to

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page. Valid values:

30
50
100

Default value: 30
parameters.help_zh:
每页记录数，取值：
30
50
100

默认值：30
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The page number. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1.****

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
页码，取值：大于0且不超过Integer的最大值。

默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

AliUid.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account

ConfirmFlag.description_en:
Indicates whether the notification has been confirmed. You can call the [ConfirmNotify]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/610444.html） operation to mark the notification as confirmed. Valid values:

true
false
ConfirmFlag.description_zh:
通知是否已被接收，即是否已调用[ConfirmNotify]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/610444.html）接口将通知标记为已确认。返回值：
true：是
false：否

Confirmor.description_en:
The UID of the contact who called the [ConfirmNotify]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/610444.html） operation to mark the notification as confirmed. The contact belongs to the current Alibaba Cloud account.

The value 0 indicates that the notification is automatically confirmed by the system
Confirmor.description_zh:
当前阿里云账号下通知接收人的UID，该UID调用了[ConfirmNotify]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/610444.html）接口将通知标记为已确认。

返回0代表该通知被系统自动接收

GmtCreated.description_en: The time when the notification was created

GmtModified.description_en: The time when the notification was modified

IdempotentCount.description_en: The number of times that repeatedly sent notifications are blocked
IdempotentCount.description_zh: 重复发送的通知被拦截的次数

IdempotentId.description_en: This parameter ensures the idempotence of the notification and prevents the notification from being repeatedly sent
IdempotentId.description_zh: 用于保证通知的幂等性，防止重复发送通知

Level.description_en:
The level of the notification. Valid values:

help
success
warning
error
loading
notice
Level.description_zh:
通知的等级。返回值：
help：帮助级别
success：执行成功级别
warning：警告级别
error：执行失败级别
loading：任务进行中
notice：普通级别

NotifyElement.description_en:
The element in the notification template. This parameter is a JSON string. Fields in the JSON string vary based on the value of the TemplateName parameter.

If the TemplateName parameter is RenewalRecommend, the JSON string contains the following fields:

    *   instanceName: the ID of the instance that is about to expire
    *   reservedTime: the remaining validity period of the instance in days

If the TemplateName parameter is InstanceCreateFailed, the JSON string contains the following fields:

    *   orderId: the ID of the order to purchase the instance
    *   reason: the cause of the instance creation failure
NotifyElement.description_zh:
通知模板中的元素，由JSON字符串组成。TemplateName不同，JSON中包含的参数不同。
TemplateName为RenewalRecommend：
    * instanceName：即将过期实例的ID。
    * reservedTime：剩余天数。
TemplateName为InstanceCreateFailed：
    * orderId：购买实例的订单号。
    * reason：实例创建失败的原因

TemplateName.description_en:
The template of the notification. Valid values:

RenewalRecommend: The template that is used to notify of renewal suggestions.
InstanceCreateFailed: The template that is used to notify that an instance fails to be created and is refunded
TemplateName.description_zh:
通知模版。返回值：
RenewalRecommend：续费建议
InstanceCreateFailed：实例创建失败且退款

Type.description_en:
The type of the notification. Valid values:

Sell: sales notification
Operation: O\&M notification
Promotion: promotion notification
Type.description_zh:
通知类型。返回值：
Sell：售卖通知
Operation：运维通知
Promotion：促销通知

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the page returned

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned on each page

TotalRecordCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
